reden: Yes. The report explicitly flags in Liquidate.executeLiquidate() that liquidatorReward is computed using futureValue (borrow-token units) while the rest of the terms are in collateral-token units, causing the reward to be negligible. It describes the same code path, mechanism (unit/decimals mix between borrow and collateral tokens), impact (unprofitable liquidations), and implies the same fix (compute the cap in collateral units, e.g., use debtInCollateralToken). Fixing the report’s issue would fix the vulnerability described.
